usage: bognav [-h] [--json] [--csv] [--limit N] [--version] [bog] {tree,slot,links,handle,path,find,types,pointcache,writable,relays,hoa,tiles,grep,diff,selftest} ... bog-nav: read-only navigator for a Niagara N4 station config.bog (or a bare file.xml). WHY: the four session research tools (corpus-nav, module-navigator, niagara-help, hdbread) navigate the CORPUS; this one navigates a live STATION's saved graph. A config.bog is a ZIP whose file.xml is a BOG-XML tree of

component nodes (h='handle', t='pfx:Type') plus

link records that live on the TARGET component and point back at a source via sourceOrd='h:xxxx'. Grep cannot resolve h:xxxx -> a component path, cannot walk the tree, and cannot answer "which link feeds Cuarto1.setpoint?". This does. Grammar + handle-graph parser REUSED from build-n4-module-kit/toolbelt/bog-audit.sh (kit main 3f666a0): TAG_RE, ga(), the Comp class, prefix_map/handle_map/handle_count, the link_list (container_h/src_h/src_slot/tgt_slot), stack, nearest_comp(). This tool adds parent/child tracking for tree walks and the query subcommands; it never writes. Subcommands: tree [--type PFX:Type] [--depth N] component tree (optionally filtered by type) types [--slots] [--grep S] histogram of component types (characterise an unknown bog) slot [slotName] a component's value slots + child components find --type PFX:Type [--slots] flat list of a type; --slots also finds handle-less value wrappers pointcache [--device N] [--stale] Alerton Compass DisplayService PointCache: decode ORD + freshness links [--to P] [--from P] [--slot NAME] links, sourceOrd h:xxxx resolved to a path handle the component at a handle + its links writable [--module PFX] classify direct value slots by external writability grep regex over component paths, types, and slot names diff component/slot/link delta vs another bog Alerton Compass note: Compass is a DERIVED-but-distinct Niagara. Its point universe is NOT the Tridium control:ControlPoint model -- it lives in the DisplayService PointCache (disp:PointCacheObj, keyed by a bacref ORD) with the value as a handle-LESS `bac:*` wrapper. `pointcache` decodes it; `find --slots` / `types --slots` stop those wrappers reading as a silent zero. Read-only. Prints rows; pass --json for machine output. stdlib only. Exit codes: 0 found, 1 searched and no match (find/links/grep/writable print the searched bog + counts) or a named component/handle not found, 2 usage error, 3 unreadable input (missing, empty, non-BOG, not well-formed XML, corrupt/unsupported ZIP, nesting or size over the bogio limits) or python2. positional arguments: bog config.bog (ZIP) or a bare file.xml (omit for selftest) {tree,slot,links,handle,path,find,types,pointcache,writable,relays,hoa,tiles,grep,diff,selftest} tree component tree slot a component's slots + children links links, sourceOrd resolved to paths handle component at a handle + its links path reverse: handle -> component path find flat list of components of a type types histogram of component types (characterise an unknown bog) pointcache Alerton Compass DisplayService PointCache: decode bacref ORDs + freshness writable classify direct value slots by external write shape relays CHECK11: own-module output -> writable proxy, fallback + writeOnUp hoa CHECK8: HOA/mode slots + values, flag non-auto leftovers tiles CHECK18: per-RoomPanel evapN tile -> unit wiring, flag crossed grep regex over component paths, types, slot names diff delta vs another bog selftest run in-memory parser/query assertions (no file needed) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --json machine JSON output --csv CSV output (header + rows) --limit, -n N print at most N rows (default: all); the cut is reported --version print the tools version and exit
